scope: Read-only frozen historical output forensics; no filter/full tracker rerun, no score or parameter change
population: All historical IDs0 through17; no selection by desired result

identity.ID1: OPERATOR_VISUAL_IDENTITY from user RViz observation; not independent GT
identity.non_ID1: manual RViz visual association only, UNKNOWN if unresolved

states: Primary metrics use frozen OBSERVED association and frozen terminal states; predictions counted separately; initial single-scan birth seeds recorded separately and never double-counted as associations
spatial_metrics: Observed states only; all-state extents separately to expose prediction extrapolation
long_observation_gap: scan-index difference >1 between successive OBSERVED associations, i.e. at least one missing scan; all gap sizes reported, no optimized cutoff
motion_metrics: XY endpoint displacement between successive observations, including gaps; not calibrated speed or certified physical path
birth_and_pending: Reconstruct membership of frozen selected clusters using original fixed DBSCAN eps2/min1 and30m query; preserve frozen choices. Audit original pending block verbatim with scan metadata attached. Compare all post-scan pending rows, DBSCAN counts and births exactly. No filter/full tracker execution
visual_protocol: All IDs: birth seed and all non-ID1 OBSERVED states, initial/middle/final ID1 views plus its known trajectory; 3D context, no predicted-only locations used to label objects; no photomask/no GNSS/no silver
